mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 2200 thousand units signals weakening residential construction activity, reducing consumer spending momentum and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 2200, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in non-farm payrolls signal deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases characterized by industrial production growth exceeding 2% annually, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as economic overheating increases recession risk.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 2% annually during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that trigger Federal Reserve tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate increases above 4.5% lead to higher equity discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
